Onten OTN-UC102 USB-C to HDMI HD Video Adapter (4K @ 60Hz)

Experience ultimate portability and flawless display performance with the Onten OTN-UC102 USB-C to HDMI HD Video Adapter. Available at Turbo Computer, this ultra-compact audio and video hardware accessory is masterfully engineered for modern laptop users, MacBook owners, and smartphone professionals across Egypt who require an instant, on-the-go external display connectivity layout. It stands as the definitive choice for pocket-sized screen expansion setups without adding clutter to your desktop setup configuration.

The Onten OTN-UC102 features a high-grade Type-C male input interface transitioning directly into an HDMI female video layout channel. Designed to handle elite high-definition media, it fully supports 4K Ultra HD resolutions running at a stable and fluid 60Hz refresh rate tracking speed. This ensures a crisp, flicker-free presentation during intense video playback, mobile gaming extensions, or office slideshow transmissions. Outfitted with a highly durable protective protective shell and an automatic plug-and-play design, it guarantees top-tier stable daily hardware performance.
